verdict.rationale: BVNK documents an API-driven, bank-transfer onramp. Customers can get fiat virtual accounts in USD, EUR or GBP inside embedded, partner-branded wallets, and a `POST /payment/v1/rules` call auto-converts incoming fiat to crypto and sends it to a blockchain address. Card purchases and a drop-in widget are not evidenced; virtual cards are for spending stablecoin balances, not buying them. Missing for 10: card-funded stablecoin purchases, an embeddable onramp widget/UI, explicit confirmation that rule-based conversion targets stablecoins, independent/hands-on corroboration.
